Summary: Version every page and iframe so the loaded build can be verified (visible build stamp, parent-iframe mismatch warning, automatic cache-busting)
Description: 1) Original intent (Founder, 2026-10-09): pages must be versioned so we can ensure the correct one is loaded. Several validation rounds were lost to an old module or iframe still running after a fix (DEF-1385 live check, 2026-10-09; earlier MAP fixes reported as 'no longer applied'). 2) Acceptance criteria: a build identifier (short git commit plus build time, and a dirty flag for uncommitted changes) is injected at build/dev-server start and shown in a small footer stamp on the React app and on each iframe page (structure-field.html, krylo2-feed.html); each iframe reports its version to the parent by postMessage on load; the parent compares it with its own and shows a visible warning with both ids when they differ; iframe src URLs carry the build id as the cache-busting query instead of the hand-edited ?v=20260917; the stamp is verifiable against git log; nothing changes for guests beyond the stamp (stamp style follows existing HUD micro-labels, no new colors). 3) Current implementation state: no build identifier in the app; krylo2-feed.html is loaded with a manually edited ?v=20260917; structure-field.html has no version; Vite hot reload can leave an old module loaded after an engine or component edit (known, memory: engine edits need a full restart). 4) Dependencies: vite.config.js (define a constant from git), public/structure-field.html, public/krylo2-feed.html, campaignfunnel.jsx and structurepanel.jsx (iframe src and message listener); CLAUDE.md section 7 (stamp is a HUD micro-label, not a report surface); the iframe load race noted in structurepanel.jsx (krylo-map-ready). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none known. 6) Maps to current product model: yes; supports the baseline and validation protocols (section 10, section 22/23 verification). Not started; needs an explicit go before code.
